questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

24 ÷ 4 + 50 – 20 × 6 = 35
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aedee98284199ee356df90ea245d041f7155eb9c7fb1b93ea16f866c9c76f640.png] 

1. × and –

Given equation: 24 ÷ 4 + 50 – 20 × 6 = 35

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 24 ÷ 4 + 50 × 20 – 6

= 6 + 50 × 20 – 6

= 6 + 1000 – 6

= 1006 – 6

= 1000 ≠ R.H.S

2. + and –

Given equation: 24 ÷ 4 + 50 – 20 × 6 = 35

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 24 ÷ 4 - 50 + 20 × 6

= 6 -

questions.solution:

Farsightedness (hyperopia) is a common vision condition in which you can see distant objects clearly, but objects nearby may be blurry.

Similarly,

Gout is a painful form of arthritis. When your body has extra uric acid, sharp crystals may form in the big toe or other joints, causing episodes of swelling and pain called gout attacks. Gout usually affects the big toe, but it can occur in any joint.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some teeth are colours.

Some colours are objects.

**Conclusions:**

I. All objects are teeth.

II. Some colours are teeth.

III. Some objects are colours.

options.text: Either conclusion I or III follows
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69dec52e242961208d0dcabe17e1995443b5c76446fec52f161315f222e82afc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef733473bf35c7e9b8c583919f5bf525811a8f9e4ca4f183c784ed57514b8a6c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All objects are teeth. → False (As, there is no definite relation between objects and teeth. Hence, false)

II. Some colours are teeth. → True (As, Some teeth are colours → Some colours are also teeth)

III. Some objects are colours. → True (As, Some colours are objects → Some objects are also colours)

Hence, **Only conclusions II and III follow**.

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Tonsil

2. Naval

3. Eardrum

4. Calf muscle

5. Thalamus
questions.solution:
The correct option that indicates the arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order is shown below:

**The given terms are names of parts of human body, arranged in the order from head to toe.**

5. Thalamus → The thalamus is a small structure within the brain located just above the brain stem between the cerebral cortex and the midbrain and has extensive nerve connections to both. 

3. Eardrum → The eardrum is a thin piece of skin-like tissue that's stretched tight — like a drum — across the opening between the ear canal and the middle ear.

1. Tonsil → The tonsils (palatine tonsils) are a pair of soft tissue masses located at the rear of the throat (pharynx).

2. Naval → The navel (clinically known as the umbilicus, commonly known as the belly button) is a protruding, flat, or hollowed area on the abdomen at the attachment site of the umbilical cord. 

4. Calf muscle → The calf is comprised of two muscles — the gastrocnemius and the soleus. These muscles meet at the Achilles tendon, which attaches directly to the heel. Any leg or foot motion uses these muscles.

Hence, ‘5-3-1-2-4’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: A drum contains 40 litres of milk. One-fourth of the milk is taken out and replaced with water. Then, half of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. What is the respective quantity of milk and water left in the drum?
questions.solution:
A drum contains 40 litres of milk.

One-fourth of the milk is taken out and replaced with water. 

One-fourth of the milk = 1/4 × 40 litres

One-fourth of the milk = 10 litres

Milk left in drum is = (40 - 10) = 30 litres 

And 10 litres of water was added.

Half of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. 

Half of 30 litres milk = 1/2 × 30 = 15 litres

And 15 litres of water was added.

The respective quantity of:

Milk left in the drum = (30 - 15) = 15 litres

Water left in the drum = (10 + 15) = 25 litres

Hence, '**15 litres and 25 litres**’ is the correct answer.
